name: Telegram Scheduling Agent
source: Sanitized documentation export. Import manually and rebind credentials.

nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.purpose: Receives Telegram messages and starts the workflow.

nodes.name: Load and Save Long-Term Context
nodes.purpose: Ensures the user_context schema exists, handles explicit /remember messages, and loads core memory for the current session.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.purpose: Plans responses, decides which tools to call, and orchestrates calendar and memory operations.

nodes.name: Google Gemini Chat Model
nodes.purpose: LLM backend for the agent. Credential is not exported.

nodes.name: Postgres Chat Memory
nodes.purpose: Stores short-term chat history by Telegram session id.

nodes.name: List Calendar Events
nodes.purpose: Reads user calendar events for planning and conflict checks.

nodes.name: Get Calendar Event
nodes.purpose: Fetches a single calendar event by id.

nodes.name: Create Calendar Event
nodes.purpose: Creates a personal Google Calendar event.

nodes.name: Update Calendar Event
nodes.purpose: Updates a personal Google Calendar event.

nodes.name: Delete Calendar Event
nodes.purpose: Deletes a personal Google Calendar event.

nodes.name: List University Schedule Events
nodes.purpose: Reads a separate read-only university schedule calendar.

nodes.name: Save Long-Term Memory
nodes.purpose: Inserts durable memory into user_context with category, priority, core flag, confidence, and optional expiration.

nodes.name: Search Long-Term Memory
nodes.purpose: Searches active long-term memory by session, category, and text.

nodes.name: Manage Long-Term Memory
nodes.purpose: Soft-expires memory rows, or expires an old row and inserts a corrected replacement.

nodes.name: Send Telegram Reply
nodes.purpose: Sends the final agent answer back to the Telegram chat.

credential_policy.telegram: Configure inside n8n. Do not commit bot tokens.
credential_policy.google_calendar: Configure OAuth inside n8n. Do not commit client secrets or calendar ids.
credential_policy.llm: Configure provider key inside n8n. Do not commit API keys.
